item.title: What It's Like to Build Teleop UIs for Real-Time Robotics
item.description: Building operator interfaces for remote robotics is a different discipline entirely. The feedback loops are tight, the stakes are real, and the UI has to be as reliable as the hardware it drives.

item.title: AI Agents, Actually: Building Systems That Do Real Work
item.description: Everyone is building AI agents. Few of them work reliably in production. Here's what I've learned about building agents that actually do the job.
